info.title: Polymarket WebSocket Alerts API
info.description:
WebSocket alerts — same events and filters as HTTP webhooks, delivered over a persistent connection. Subscriptions are ephemeral and end when you disconnect.

## Connection

```
wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts
```

All alert channels share this endpoint. Each channel below represents one event type.

## Authentication

**API key** — pass via header or query param:
```
X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<your-api-key>
```

**Public-key JWT** — for `pk_jwt_*` keys. Your users authenticate with a JWT you sign; credits are charged to your org.
```
Authorization: Bearer <end-user-jwt>
```
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?token=<end-user-jwt>
```

## Protocol

Subscribe and unsubscribe by sending JSON messages:
```json
{ "op": "subscribe", "event": "trader_whale_trade", "min_usd_value": 10000 }
```

Server responds with `{"op":"subscribed", ...}`. Events are pushed as `{"event":"...","timestamp":...,"data":...}`.

## Keepalive

Send `{"type":"ping"}` every 30s. Server responds with `{"type":"pong"}`. Connections idle for more than 60 seconds are closed.

## Pricing

**1-2 credits per alert**, same as the equivalent HTTP webhook. See each channel for its specific cost.

ws_alerts.trader_first_trade.title: First Trade
ws_alerts.trader_first_trade.description:
Fired when a tracked trader executes their first trade on Polymarket

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `wallet_addresses`, `min_usd_value`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `one_shot`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

**Applicable filters:** `wallet_addresses`, `min_usd_value`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `one_shot`

ws_alerts.position_liquidity.title: Position Liquidity Threshold
ws_alerts.position_liquidity.description:
Fired when a position's USD order-book liquidity crosses a threshold. **`position_ids` is required**, plus at least one of `min_liquidity_usd` (fires when liquidity crosses **up** through the value) or `max_liquidity_usd` (fires when it crosses **down**). Thresholds are edge-triggered and re-arm once liquidity crosses back, unless `one_shot` is set (fire once, then delete).

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `position_ids`, `min_liquidity_usd`, `max_liquidity_usd`, `one_shot`

Optional `milestone_amounts` restricts to specific USD thresholds (e.g. `[10000, 100000]`). Optional `condition_ids` restricts to specific markets.

**Credits cost:** 200 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `condition_ids`, `timeframes`, `milestone_amounts`, `one_shot`

ws_alerts.price_spike.title: Price Spike
ws_alerts.price_spike.description:
Fired when a position's price moves significantly. Use `min_price_change_pct` to set the minimum move (e.g. `10` for 10%). Use `window_secs` to observe moves within a specific time window. Use `spike_direction` (`"up"` | `"down"` | `"both"`) — defaults to `"up"` when not provided. Filter by `position_ids` or `outcomes` to narrow scope. Scope by market taxonomy with `tags` (matches a market's tags or category) and `series_slugs` (matches its parent series). Optional `min_price`/`max_price` gate the price band, `min_txns`/`min_volume_usd` require a minimum number of trades or USD volume in the observation window.

**Credits cost:** 200 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `position_ids`, `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `tags`, `series_slugs`, `outcomes`, `min_price_change_pct`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `min_txns`, `min_volume_usd`, `spike_direction`, `window_secs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `one_shot`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

ws_alerts.market_volume_spike.title: Market Volume Spike
ws_alerts.market_volume_spike.description:

Optional `window_secs` sets the observation window in seconds (max 600). Optional `timeframes` — valid values: `1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `1h`, `6h`, `1d`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`, `lifetime`. Optional `condition_ids` restricts to specific markets.

**Credits cost:** 200 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `spike_ratio`, `window_secs`, `condition_ids`, `timeframes`, `one_shot`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

ws_alerts.close_to_bond.title: Close To Bond
ws_alerts.close_to_bond.description:
Fired when a trade occurs at a near-certain-outcome price. The alert matches on the traded position's own price — so you receive the trade for the exact `position_id` that hit the threshold. **At least one of `min_price` or `max_price` is required.** Use `min_price` (e.g. `0.95`) to trigger when the traded outcome is near-certain (price ≥ threshold); use `max_price` (e.g. `0.05`) for the near-zero side (price ≤ threshold). Optional filters: `position_outcome_indices` — restrict by outcome index (`0` = Yes/Up, `1` = No); `condition_ids` — restrict to specific markets; `position_ids` — restrict to specific outcome tokens; `outcomes` — restrict by outcome name (e.g. `"Yes"`, `"No"`); `event_slugs` — restrict to specific events. Scope by market taxonomy with `tags` (matches a market's tags or category) and `series_slugs` (matches its parent series).

**Credits cost:** 200 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `min_price`, `max_price`, `condition_ids`, `position_ids`, `outcomes`, `position_outcome_indices`, `event_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `tags`, `series_slugs`, `one_shot`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

ws_alerts.price_threshold.title: Price Threshold Crossing
ws_alerts.price_threshold.description:
Fired when an outcome's price crosses a target level (edge-triggered, fires once per crossing). **At least one of `min_price` or `max_price` is required.** Use `min_price` (e.g. `0.75`) to fire when the price crosses *up* to ≥ that level; use `max_price` (e.g. `0.25`) to fire when it crosses *down* to ≤ that level. Set `one_shot` to delete the subscription after the first delivery (requires `position_ids` or `condition_ids`). Set `fire_if_already_past` to fire immediately when the first observed price is already past the target. Optional scope filters: `condition_ids`, `position_ids`, `outcomes`, `position_outcome_indices` (`0` = Yes/Up, `1` = No), `event_slugs`, `tags` (a market's tags or category), `series_slugs` (parent series).

**Credits cost:** 200 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `min_price`, `max_price`, `one_shot`, `fire_if_already_past`, `condition_ids`, `position_ids`, `outcomes`, `position_outcome_indices`, `event_slugs`, `tags`, `series_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

ws_alerts.market_resolved.title: Market Resolved
ws_alerts.market_resolved.description:
Fired once when a market reaches a terminal resolution. Collapses the underlying oracle events (`QuestionResolved`, `QuestionEmergencyResolved`, `ConditionResolution`, `NegRiskOutcomeReported`) into a single notification carrying the winning outcome and, when available, the settled price. Optional filters: `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `outcomes` (only fire when the winning outcome matches, e.g. `"Yes"`), `exclude_shortterm_markets`.

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `outcomes`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `one_shot`

Connection: `wss://api.struct.to/ws/alerts?api-key=<key>` — all alert channels share the same physical endpoint.

ws_alerts.market_disputed.title: Market Disputed
ws_alerts.market_disputed.description:
Fired when a proposed market resolution is challenged on-chain (`DisputePrice` or `AssertionDisputed`) — the resolution is now contested and delayed. Carries the disputer, the proposer, and the disputed/proposed outcome when available. Optional filters: `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`.

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

**Applicable filters:** `condition_ids`, `event_slugs`, `exclude_shortterm_markets`, `one_shot`

Optional `condition_ids` narrows by market.

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

ws_alerts.asset_price_window_update.title: Asset Price Window Update
ws_alerts.asset_price_window_update.description:
Fired at the start and end of each price candle for tracked crypto assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, BNB, HYPE). Payload includes `update_type` (`"open"` or `"close"`) indicating whether the candle is opening or closing. Use `asset_symbols` to restrict to specific assets. Use `timeframes` to restrict to specific candle sizes — valid values: `"5m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"4h"`, `"1d"`, `"24h"`.

**Credits cost:** 100 per delivered alert.

The trade-driven events `price_spike` and

category) and `series_slugs` (matches the market's parent series); these are
resolved from the tags/series the crawler enriches onto each trade.

- volume_milestone: condition_ids, timeframes, milestone_amounts
- close_to_bond: min_price (high zone threshold), max_price (low zone threshold), condition_ids, tags, series_slugs, position_ids, outcomes, position_outcome_indices, event_slugs, exclude_shortterm_markets
- market_created: event_slugs, tags, exclude_shortterm_markets
- price_spike: condition_ids, event_slugs, tags, series_slugs, outcomes, min_price_change_pct, spike_direction, window_secs, exclude_shortterm_markets
- trader_new_trade: wallet_addresses, min_usd_value, min_price, max_price, condition_ids, event_slugs, trade_types, exclude_shortterm_markets

- trader_market_pnl: traders, min_realized_pnl_usd, max_realized_pnl_usd, min_buy_usd, condition_ids, event_slugs, exclude_shortterm_markets
